blocks.source: 質量／物語
blocks.translation: Weight / Story

blocks.source: ８人いる主人公から好きなキャラクターを選んで旅をする。誰を選ぶかによって、主に序盤のストーリーが変化する。ただし、様々な場所からスタートするロマサガ１と比較すると、変化は乏しい。
blocks.translation: Choose your favorite character from among eight protagonists and set out on a journey. The early part of the story changes mainly depending on whom you choose. However, compared with Romancing SaGa 1, where you start in various locations, the changes are rather limited.

blocks.source: シリーズお馴染みのフリーシナリオは健在。「四魔貴族を倒し、アビスゲートを閉じる」という目的を除けば、何をやるのも自由だ。単純にストーリーが良いと評価される事は少ない本作ではあるが、１つ１つのイベントを取ってみると濃いものだってある。特にバンガード関連のイベントはストーリー面・演出面共に優れているし、イベント達成までの手順に多少の自由度もあるのが面白い。
blocks.translation: The series' familiar free-form scenario is alive and well. Apart from the goal of “defeating the Four Sinistrals and closing the Abyss Gates,” you are free to do whatever you want. Although this game is rarely praised simply for having a good story, some individual events are quite substantial. The Vanguard-related events in particular are excellent in both story and presentation, and it is interesting that you also have some freedom in how you go about completing them.

blocks.source: 複雑な国家情勢が設定されていたりと、ストーリーよりも舞台を作る事に重点を置いている印象を受ける。ロマサガ１，２と比較すると、全般的に起こせるイベントが少なく手詰まりになりやすい。イベントが少ないというよりも、難易度が低くあっさり終わるイベントが多いせいかも。
blocks.translation: The game seems to place more emphasis on creating its setting than on its story, with a complex political situation among the nations. Compared with Romancing SaGa 1 and 2, there are generally fewer events that can be triggered, making it easier to reach a dead end. It may not be that there are fewer events, but rather that there are more low-difficulty events that end rather quickly.

blocks.source: 後半までは主人公達が四魔貴族と戦う動機が不明というのは難点。その後半の展開も唐突で、某キャラと関係の無い主人公の場合は動機付けに無理がある。東方世界の雰囲気作りはとても良いのだが、余りイベントが多くなくて残念。
blocks.translation: It is a drawback that the protagonists' motivation for fighting the Four Sinistrals remains unclear until the latter half. The developments in that latter half are also abrupt, and when you play as a protagonist unrelated to a certain character, the motivation feels forced. The atmosphere of the Eastern World is very well created, but it is disappointing that there are not many events.

blocks.source: システム／バランス
blocks.translation: Systems / Balance

blocks.source: ゲームシステムはロマサガ１、２のいいとこ取り。基本は１に近く、２の様にキャラクターがコロコロ入れ替わることは無い。『閃き』『陣形』といった２で好評だったシステムをしっかり継承している。また、『マスコンバット』『トレード』など作品独自のミニゲームも魅力的。
blocks.translation: The game system takes the best parts of Romancing SaGa 1 and 2. It is basically closer to 1, and unlike 2, the characters do not constantly rotate in and out. It properly carries over systems that were well received in 2, such as “Glimmer” and “Formations.” It also has appealing original minigames such as “Mass Combat” and “Trade.”

blocks.source: ザコ敵は弱めなのでサクサク進む。というか、筆者は何週もしているがザコ戦でまともに戦って全滅した覚えが無い。それでいて、ボス敵は絶妙な強さという組み合わせ。さすがに、ザコ敵はもう少し強くていい気もするが、遊びやすさはピカ一。
blocks.translation: The regular enemies are on the weak side, so you progress smoothly. In fact, although I have played through it many times, I do not remember ever being wiped out in a regular battle while fighting seriously. Meanwhile, the bosses have just the right level of strength, making for a good combination. The regular enemies could probably be a little stronger, but the ease of play is outstanding.

blocks.source: ラスボスは２のように理不尽に強くは無いが、やり方次第では強くもなるので、手応えを求める人も満足だと思う。 このシリーズは技・術のバリエーションが豊富で取れる戦術が大きい事も魅力だ。
blocks.translation: The final boss is not unreasonably strong like the one in 2, but it can be quite powerful depending on your approach, so I think players looking for a challenge will be satisfied. Another appeal of this series is its wide variety of skills and spells, which allows for a broad range of tactics.

blocks.source: 主人公が戦闘の指揮官となる『コンバットモード』に付いては、使用しなくてもクリアできるし、扱いが中途半端な印象も受ける。それでも、２周目以降のプレイで試してみると、また感覚が違ってまた楽しめる。でも、ギャラクシーやクリムゾンフレアといった最強レベルの合体術はダメージが９９９９で打ち止めなせいで、終盤は余り強くないのが寂しい。
blocks.translation: As for “Combat Mode,” in which the protagonist becomes the battle commander, the game can be cleared without using it, and it also feels somewhat half-finished. Even so, trying it on a second or subsequent playthrough gives the game a different feel and makes it enjoyable in a new way. However, it is disappointing that powerful combination spells such as Galaxy and Crimson Flare are not very strong toward the end because their damage caps at 9,999.

blocks.source: 快適性
blocks.translation: Ease of Play

blocks.source: 戦闘テンポに付いては、後のミンストレルソングより実は劣る。技名表示に時間が掛かったりと色々な所に間があるので比較してみると気になる。とはいえ、SFCの中では速い方だとは思う。
blocks.translation: The battle tempo is actually worse than that of the later Minstrel Song. There are pauses in various places, such as the time it takes to display skill names, which become noticeable when you compare them. That said, I think it is still on the faster side among SFC games.

blocks.source: どこでもセーブの他、Ｘボタンで町から脱出できるなど、シリーズお馴染みの親切要素は引き継いでいる。
blocks.translation: Along with being able to save anywhere, the game carries over the series' familiar conveniences, such as being able to escape from towns with the X button.

blocks.source: 気になったのは地雷となる仲間キャラが多いこと。
blocks.translation: What bothered me was the large number of troublesome party members.

blocks.source: うっかり仲間にした場合、条件を満たさないと外せない。
blocks.translation: If you accidentally recruit them, you cannot remove them unless you meet certain conditions.

blocks.source: （詩人、タチアナ、ハーマン）
blocks.translation: (The Poet, Tatiana, and Herman)

blocks.source: この３人は気を付ければ問題ないのだが、初プレイではギョッとした。
blocks.translation: These three are no problem if you are careful, but they gave me quite a shock on my first playthrough.

blocks.source: 途中で外れるので、ラストバトルに連れて行けない。（某２名）
blocks.translation: They leave partway through, so you cannot take them into the final battle. (Two particular characters)

blocks.source: 知らずに仲間にしていた場合はご愁傷様としか言い用がない。
blocks.translation: If you recruited them without knowing this, all I can say is: my condolences.

blocks.source: 美術
blocks.translation: Art

blocks.source: キャラクターの頭身はSFCRPGの中では高め。モンスターデザイン、マップデザイン、戦闘アニメーションの３点はドット絵RPGの中でも最高峰だと思う。
blocks.translation: The characters have relatively realistic proportions for an SFC RPG. I think the monster designs, map designs, and battle animations are all among the very best in pixel-art RPGs.

blocks.source: モンスターデザインの中でも、ボス敵のグラフィックは書き込みもデザインセンスも凄まじい。四魔貴族関連のダンジョンはいずれもSFCRPG屈指の造形。特に魔王殿のインパクトは音楽も合わさって、そこらのRPGのラストダンジョンを凌ぐ。戦闘アニメーションがこれだけ豊富なRPGもSFCでは他にあるかどうか。
blocks.translation: Among the monster designs, the boss graphics are astounding both in their level of detail and their design sense. Every dungeon associated with the Four Sinistrals is among the finest creations in SFC RPGs. The Palace of the Great Demon King's impact, in particular, enhanced by its music, surpasses that of the final dungeons in many other RPGs. I wonder whether any other SFC RPG has such a rich selection of battle animations.

blocks.source: 音楽
blocks.translation: Music

blocks.source: 相変わらず戦闘曲が格好いいが、中でも四魔貴族戦（×２）とラスボス戦の評価は別格。これを全RPGのベストラスボス曲に押す人も珍しくない。ダンジョンや町の曲のバリエーションも豊か。欲を言えば、主人公毎のテーマ曲が１と比べて少し地味だったかなあと。
blocks.translation: The battle music is as cool as ever, but the Four Sinistrals' battles (×2) and the final boss battle stand out above the rest. It is not uncommon for people to rank them among the best final boss themes in all RPGs. The dungeon and town music also offers plenty of variety. If I had to find something to complain about, I would say that the individual protagonists' theme songs were a little more subdued than those in 1.

blocks.source: まとめ
blocks.translation: Conclusion

blocks.source: ロマサガ３作はそれぞれ違った魅力を持っている。マニア受けでは１、完成度では２だと思う。３は前２作と比べると、遊びやすく、おまけ要素も豊富なので、気がついたら何周もしていたなんて人も多いはず。
blocks.translation: The three Romancing SaGa games each have their own distinct appeal. I think 1 is the favorite among enthusiasts, while 2 is the most polished. Compared with the first two games, 3 is easier to play and has plenty of bonus content, so many people probably found themselves playing through it several times before they knew it.

blocks.source: ところで、こういうフリーシナリオで遊び応えのあるRPGが再び現れる日はもう無いのだろうか……。時間さえあれば、僕が自分で作りたいと思うものの……。
blocks.translation: By the way, will the day ever come when another engaging RPG with a free-form scenario like this appears? If only I had the time, I would like to make one myself...
